Tabakfeld auf der Gemarkung Sandhausen (Rhein-Neckar-Kreis). Die Kulturpflanze benötigt sandige Böden und warmes Klima.

Protoplasts are plant cells deprived of the cell wall thanks to the combined action of the cellulase and pectinase enzymes. The protoplast in the photo, isolated from the foliar mesophyll of a tobacco
